lines.t: Caught webs and plastic grins, strangers knocking at my door
Masks of fear dress up the night, but I don't want them anymore
Candles flicker for the dead, hollow laughter fills the street
What glory lies in shadows, what prize for cold to see
You can keep your paper witches, keep your costume parade
I won't dance with death and darkness In the light I remain
No shadows for a crown No revels for the lost
Turn away from borrowed graveyards Count the true cost
Lights and pumpkins line the path
Old lies wrapped up as sweet
Trading innocence for pranks
While darkness clings to feet
Tinsel on a coffin
Is still decay inside
I won't borrow pagan stories for the blood that's crucified
You can keep your paper witches, keep your costume parade
I won't dance with death and darkness in the light I'm remade
No shadows for a crown, no rebels for the law
Turn away from borrowed graveyards
Count the true cards
Let autumn's gold remind us of the maker's hand alone
Not the empty pride of midnight masks
Or the echo of a stone
So I'll walk among the living, sing a higher song
Cast off these empty rituals where the faithful belong
Thanks for watching!
